page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-8-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 63.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include GPU accelerators, and local storage is listed as none, requiring external block storage for persistent data.

Due to the dedicated allocation of its 8 vCPUs, this instance provides predictable compute performance without the resource sharing typical of burstable tiers. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes it suitable for memory-intensive tasks, though the lack of integrated local storage and GPU hardware limits its utility for high-speed local caching or hardware-accelerated machine learning workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this server offers a high density of memory relative to its compute core count, making it a viable option for workloads that require significant memory capacity without the expense of scaling up to higher vCPU tiers. Recommended workloads include memory-cached applications, medium-sized databases, enterprise applications, and general-purpose workloads requiring a larger memory footprint.
